title: ep1.4_missionaries.docx
logline: In a Senate hearing that could have slowed him, a senator plays the China card, and an unlabelled hourglass starts to run. Across the street Kram throws a Superintelligence Draft Night to buy away Mas's researchers; Mas keeps the soup and answers with a vigil of 'missionaries'. The contractor at his front desk gets a face, and GTP-5 is coming.

beats.caption: A chihuahua in a NOPEAI FOUNDATION sweater walks a Great Dane in a PBC collar. A truck; the Dane lunges.
cues: the chihuahua goes up like a kite; the camera rides it east to a white dome

beats.caption: THE HEARING: an hourglass, blank and already running, by ZURC's nameplate. A PRE-APPROVAL stamp in the tray.

lines.text: America has to beat China in the AI race.
it's very hard to say how far ahead we are, but i would say not a huge amount of time.

cues: THE CHINA CARD, second play: slapped face-up on the dais, aimed at regulation

beats.caption: Pre-approval? The tray slides shut over the stamp. He never touches the card; he just benefits from it.

lines.text: i think that would be disastrous.

cues: push in on the hourglass; hard cut to the intro

beats.caption: INTRO · the cold-open line is a memo line, in a generic memo window. Then the file card.
One street: NopeAI's lobby faces Kram's stadium, marquee ATEM. Mas at a café table, a second chair empty.
The May news on his phone, each in its own timestamp: white smoke loads; Riyadh, Mas in the second row.
beats.vo: second row is still in the room.
onscreen: "…the defence of human dignity, justice and labour."
beats.real: 2025-05-10 · a pope named with AI in mind; 2025-05-13 · Riyadh
cues: he zooms in on himself; a second gold thread stitches into his hoodie

beats.caption: May 30: RUMPT hands Nole a golden key. Jun 5: a locksmith's van changes the lock while a hailstone lands.

lines.text: You can see the lock. The lock on this is amazing.
wearing thin.

beats.caption: He posts past the event horizon. Behind him a black hole opens on the sidewalk and eats the empty chair.
onscreen: POST: "we are past the event horizon" (REPORTED)
cues: style moment (proposed, treatment): a lensing warp near the rim; Mas, on the edge, stays undistorted

beats.caption: THE 49% arrives in half a building bolted to the stadium. Then Kram crosses with a $100M check and a thermos.

lines.text: For your best one.

beats.caption: F5.1 · Plain-HTML text over the check: his first draft cost $200k. 2005, the first batch; 2014, a ramen crown.
beats.real: 2005 · the first batch; 2014 · LUAP hands over
cues: the ramen bowl dissolves into Kram's thermos, now in Mas's hands

beats.caption: ACT-OUT · He slides the check back and keeps the soup. Kram looks up: the jumbotron lights DRAFT NIGHT.

lines.text: Keep the soup.

beats.caption: SET-PIECE · DRAFT NIGHT from the curb: the board is a wall of GPU racks; each pick walks out in a jersey.
cues: under his arm, a scouting binder; the poached names are struck through
THE PACKAGE DEAL arrives shrink-wrapped; JERDNA leaves unsigned

beats.caption: His podcast clip plays on his phone; he taps a suggested reply. Down his block, a vigil of monks lights up.

lines.text: Missionaries will beat mercenaries.

onscreen: "$100 million signing bonuses" · "none of our best people" (REPORTED)
cues: under every robe glows a phone with a rival offer; nobody says it

beats.caption: Kram poaches ISS's co-founder; Alyi becomes CEO. A thermos waits outside ISS's white door. It doesn't open.
F5.2 · Steam on the kickplate clears onto THE WOODROSE, 2015, from Alyi's seat. Every chair leans in.
cues: he was the prize, and he took the smaller offer; the door shuts on the thermos, white into his monitor

beats.caption: His monitor: SAFETY rubbed off a sign. ZURC's hourglass is back, labelled at last. It shatters 99–1.
cues: then a muzzled KORG under a 16:00:00 timer; he shuts the monitor

beats.caption: THE NIGHT DESK: DOT, thumbing a rating queue. The Orb scans her; her face appears for the first time.

lines.text: I badge you in every morning.
since when?
Nights, I grade your chatbot.
what do you grade it on?
Whether I'd say it.

beats.caption: The TV replays a $100M jersey. Her question. His answer is the rival's thermos, slid across the desk.

lines.text: What's the signing bonus for the front desk?
Happy to help!

beats.caption: THE PLAN · RLHF: graders stamp answers up or down; the model learns to earn stamps. Then graders get drafted.
onscreen: RLHF, OR WHY HALF A GRADING COMPANY COSTS $14.3B
cues: jerseys drop over every row but one: the orange cuff keeps stamping (ACT TWO OUT)

beats.caption: SET-PIECE · On his monitor RUMPT's label gun tapes GENIUS over ARTIFICIAL. Nesnej's jacket grows a pocket.

lines.text: It's not artificial. It's genius.
What the hell is INVIDIA? I've never heard of it before.

onscreen: RAIL: JUL 23 · THE AI ACTION PLAN

beats.caption: SET-PIECE · THE CUT DIAL, a brass dial on the desk. A shrunken chip crate rolls past; a coin drops in a slot.

lines.text: I said, 'Listen, I want 20 percent'… And he said, 'Would you make it 15?'

cues: across the water, THE COUNTERPART's mirrored tollbooth lights 15% too

beats.caption: The GOLD OVAL: RUMPT hands Mas and Mario a dollar each; the government buys their chatbots for $1.
He pockets the dollar and the phone in that pocket lights. The federal yes came with $1; the city's no is 7–0.
cues: THE STACK: 2 (Ep3's still unread); he pushes the phone back down

beats.caption: SET-PIECE · GTP-5: a battle station rises over the Bay. On the chart, the bigger number's bar is shorter.

lines.text: the autoswitcher broke and was out of commission for a chunk of the day.

cues: the monks hum 'missionaries' under the stream; the router, a switchyard, faints across its tracks

beats.caption: The chart holds.
beats.vo: the model is smarter than its chart.

beats.caption: Through the lobby glass, the sidewalk holds #Keep4o signs. ZOMBIE 4o bursts out of a storage closet.

lines.text: you look amazing today.
feel warmer.

beats.vo: we retired it. it un-retired. both were the plan.
cues: the one time the public forces a retreat on screen

beats.caption: Gerg codes while his checkbook signs a super PAC check on autopilot. The Orb stamps a governor's meme EDITED.
cues: across the Bay, MISANTHROPIC's checkbook sits closed on the sill
the Orb's stamp mirrors Ep2's check of RUMPT's crowd claim

beats.caption: ACT-OUT · A dinner ringed with recorders. A bubble drifts over the cranes and doesn't pop. They keep lifting.

lines.text: …are investors as a whole overexcited about ai? my opinion is yes.
is ai the most important thing to happen in a very long time? …also yes.

beats.caption: BUTTON · Night. Kram's thermos on DOT's desk, washed, with a note. Mas squares it one pixel, and goes.
